h1: Window cleaning in Ridge at Alta Vista
intro: The Ridge at Alta Vista is a gated subdivision off Lohmans Crossing with late 1990s and 2000s stucco homes. CleanzATX cleans here and knows how stucco and glass need to be handled.

sections.h2: What Ridge at Alta Vista homes are like
paragraphs: Most homes here were built in the late 1990s and 2000s, and stucco is the common finish. Sizes run from about 2,000 to 4,000 square feet, with prices from $600K to $1.2M. Listings describe the subdivision as gated, and the Ridge at Alta Vista HOA manages common areas, including a pool. The location is convenient, just off Lohmans Crossing and close to Lakeway shopping and schools.
Houses of this age have mature oaks and shrubs around them. Many owners have already replaced a few windows, so the glass may be a mix of original and newer units.

sections.h2: What Ridge at Alta Vista windows deal with
paragraphs: Stucco sheds fine dust over time, and rain carries it down onto the glass below. White streaks under sills are common. Limestone dust adds to that on hills, and live oak pollen coats everything in spring. Cedar season runs from December to February.

Sprinklers aimed near stucco leave mineral spots on both the wall and the glass, and these can look like permanent stains. Older stucco can also grow algae in shaded areas. We clean glass with pure water so no soap film remains on the pane, and we deal with spots using hard water removal at $10 per pane.

sections.h2: How we work Ridge at Alta Vista
paragraphs: Gate access is the first step. Send the code or the name of the person who can let us in, and we plan around it. We use poles from the ground for exterior glass, which keeps ladders off stucco. The 12V soft wash system cleans stucco without high pressure, and we never use a pressure washer on it. If your HOA has pool hours or quiet times, tell us when you text.

For a 3,000 square foot home, expect about $300 for exterior windows and roughly two to three hours on site. Add the inside and the price becomes $15 per window. House soft wash starts at $0.20 per square foot with a $400 minimum.
